glossary.definition: The same service billed more than once with identical details.
Exact dollars come from implicated claim lines; estimated dollars are inferred (not used in this build).
HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW, computed by fixed rules from independent evidence channels. LOW items are monitored, not opened as cases.

limitations.text: All data in this system is synthetic.
Network analysis covers shared owners, buildings, phones, facilities and referrals in the synthetic data; relationships outside that data cannot be assessed.

policies.text: A line identical to an earlier line for the same member, rendering provider, date of service, code, modifiers and units is treated as a duplicate submission and is not payable twice.
policies.title: Duplicate submissions
